fullText.simplified:
曹操的话

    曹操看到他的朋友拿着刀，心想：“他要杀我！”曹操很生气，就杀了他的朋友和朋友的家人。
    后来，他发现那里有一只羊，房间里还有热水。他突然明白了：他的朋友是要拿刀杀羊，做饭给他吃。他看着他的朋友，没有说话。然后，他骑上马，跑了。

    曹操跑到自己的老家。他知道，董卓不会放过他，一定会杀他。如果他不想被杀，就只能杀了董卓。董卓有那么多军队，想要杀董卓，他要人，他要军队！所以，曹操在老家对别人说：“董卓是一个坏人！因为他，皇帝不能好好工作了。皇帝很怕他，让我杀了他。但是我在杀他的时候，被他发现了。所以，现在董卓让很多人来找我，他想杀我。让我们为了皇帝，一起努力，杀了董卓吧！董卓不在了，皇帝就能好好工作了！”曹操没有说真话，但是他知道，他要这么说！人们听皇帝的话，所以他要说是皇帝要他杀董卓的。
    那个时候，人们都没有钱吃饭。大家都想：如果皇帝能好好工作，他们就有钱吃饭了。所以，真的像曹操想的那样，他这么说了以后，大家都相信了他的话，很多人都来到了曹操身边。曹操有了第一个自己的军队。很多地方的将军也来到了曹操身边，大家决定：一起打董卓！
fullText.traditional:
曹操的話

    曹操看到他的朋友拿著刀，心想：“他要殺我！”曹操很生氣，就殺了他的朋友和朋友的家人。
    後來，他發現那裡有一隻羊，房間裡還有熱水。他突然明白了：他的朋友是要拿刀殺羊，做飯給他吃。他看著他的朋友，沒有說話。然後，他騎上馬，跑了。

    曹操跑到自己的老家。他知道，董卓不會放過他，一定會殺他。如果他不想被殺，就只能殺了董卓。董卓有那麼多軍隊，想要殺董卓，他要人，他要軍隊！所以，曹操在老家對別人說：“董卓是一個壞人！因為他，皇帝不能好好工作了。皇帝很怕他，讓我殺了他。但是我在殺他的時候，被他發現了。所以，現在董卓讓很多人來找我，他想殺我。讓我們為了皇帝，一起努力，殺了董卓吧！董卓不在了，皇帝就能好好工作了！”曹操沒有說真話，但是他知道，他要這麼說！人們聽皇帝的話，所以他要說是皇帝要他殺董卓的。
    那個時候，人們都沒有錢吃飯。大家都想：如果皇帝能好好工作，他們就有錢吃飯了。所以，真的像曹操想的那樣，他這麼說了以後，大家都相信了他的話，很多人都來到了曹操身邊。曹操有了第一個自己的軍隊。很多地方的將軍也來到了曹操身邊，大家決定：一起打董卓！

sentences.traditional: 曹操看到他的朋友拿著刀，心想：“他要殺我！”

sentences.simplified: 曹操很生气，就杀了他的朋友和朋友的家人。
sentences.traditional: 曹操很生氣，就殺了他的朋友和朋友的家人。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn shēng qì jiù shā le tā de péng you hé péng you de jiā rén
sentences.english: Cao Cao got very angry and killed his friend as well as his friend’s family.

sentences.simplified: 后来，他发现那里有一只羊，房间里还有热水。
sentences.traditional: 後來，他發現那裡有一隻羊，房間裡還有熱水。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā fā xiàn nà lǐ yǒu yì zhī yáng fáng jiān lǐ hái yǒu rè shuǐ
sentences.english: Afterward, he discovered that there was a goat there, and there was also hot water inside the room.

sentences.simplified: 他突然明白了：他的朋友是要拿刀杀羊，做饭给他吃。
sentences.traditional: 他突然明白了：他的朋友是要拿刀殺羊，做飯給他吃。
sentences.pinyin: tā tū rán míng bai le tā de péng you shì yào ná dāo shā yáng zuò fàn gěi tā chī
sentences.english: He suddenly realized: His friend was going to kill the goat with the sword to prepare a meal for him to eat.

sentences.simplified: 他看着他的朋友，没有说话。然后，他骑上马，跑了。
sentences.traditional: 他看著他的朋友，沒有說話。然後，他騎上馬，跑了。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe tā de péng you méi yǒu shuō huà rán hòu tā qí shàng mǎ pǎo le
sentences.english: He looked at his friend, and didn’t say anything. Then, he mounted his horse and fled.

sentences.simplified: 曹操跑到自己的老家。他知道，董卓不会放过他，一定会杀他。
sentences.traditional: 曹操跑到自己的老家。他知道，董卓不會放過他，一定會殺他。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo pǎo dào zì jǐ de lǎo jiā tā zhī dào dǒng zhuó bú huì fàng guò tā yí dìng huì shā tā
sentences.english: Cao Cao fled to his hometown. He knew that Dong Zhuo would not let him off; he would definitely kill him.

sentences.simplified: 如果他不想被杀，就只能杀了董卓。
sentences.traditional: 如果他不想被殺，就只能殺了董卓。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ tā bù xiǎng bèi shā jiù zhǐ néng shā le dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: If he did not want to be killed, then he had no choice but to kill Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 董卓有那么多军队，想要杀董卓，他要人，他要军队！
sentences.traditional: 董卓有那麼多軍隊，想要殺董卓，他要人，他要軍隊！
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó yǒu nà me duō jūn duì xiǎng yào shā dǒng zhuó tā yào rén tā yào jūn duì
sentences.english: Dong Zhuo had so many troops, that if he wanted to kill Dong Zhuo, he needed people, he needed troops!

sentences.simplified: 所以，曹操在老家对别人说：“董卓是一个坏人！
sentences.traditional: 所以，曹操在老家對別人說：“董卓是一個壞人！
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ cáo cāo zài lǎo jiā duì bié ren shuō dǒng zhuó shì yí ge huài rén
sentences.english: Therefore, Cao Cao said to the people in his hometown, “Dong Zhuo is an evil person!

sentences.simplified: 因为他，皇帝不能好好工作了。皇帝很怕他，让我杀了他。
sentences.traditional: 因為他，皇帝不能好好工作了。皇帝很怕他，讓我殺了他。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tā huáng dì bù néng hǎo hǎo gōng zuò le huáng dì hěn pà tā ràng wǒ shā le tā
sentences.english: Because of him, the emperor is unable to do his job well. The emperor is afraid of him and asked me to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 但是我在杀他的时候，被他发现了。
sentences.traditional: 但是我在殺他的時候，被他發現了。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì wǒ zài shā tā de shí hou bèi tā fā xiàn le
sentences.english: But when I was about to kill him, I was found out.

sentences.simplified: 所以，现在董卓让很多人来找我，他想杀我。
sentences.traditional: 所以，現在董卓讓很多人來找我，他想殺我。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xiàn zài dǒng zhuó ràng hěn duō rén lái zhǎo wǒ tā xiǎng shā wǒ
sentences.english: Therefore, Dong Zhuo has now sent many people to find me. He wants to kill me.

sentences.simplified: 让我们为了皇帝，一起努力，杀了董卓吧！
sentences.traditional: 讓我們為了皇帝，一起努力，殺了董卓吧！
sentences.pinyin: ràng wǒ men wèi le huáng dì yì qǐ nǔ lì shā le dǒng zhuó ba
sentences.english: For the sake of the emperor, let’s work together and kill Dong Zhuo!

sentences.simplified: 董卓不在了，皇帝就能好好工作了！”
sentences.traditional: 董卓不在了，皇帝就能好好工作了！”
sentences.pinyin: dǒng zhuó bú zài le huáng dì jiù néng hǎo hǎo gōng zuò le
sentences.english: If Dong Zhuo is no longer alive, the emperor will be able to do his job well!”

sentences.traditional: 曹操沒有說真話，但是他知道，他要這麼說！

sentences.english: Everyone thought: If the emperor is able to do his job well, they will have money to eat.

sentences.english: So, just as Cao Cao had thought, after he spoke, everyone believed his words, and many people came to Cao Cao’s side.

sentences.traditional: 曹操有了第一個自己的軍隊。

sentences.simplified: 很多地方的将军也来到了曹操身边，大家决定：一起打董卓！

sentences.english: Generals from many places also came to Cao Cao’s side. Everyone decided that they would fight Dong Zhuo together!

sentence_translations: Cao Cao’s Story
Cao Cao saw that his friend held a sword and thought, “He is going to kill me!”
Cao Cao got very angry and killed his friend as well as his friend’s family.
Afterward, he discovered that there was a goat there, and there was also hot water inside the room.
He suddenly realized: His friend was going to kill the goat with the sword to prepare a meal for him to eat.
He looked at his friend, and didn’t say anything. Then, he mounted his horse and fled.
Cao Cao fled to his hometown. He knew that Dong Zhuo would not let him off; he would definitely kill him.
If he did not want to be killed, then he had no choice but to kill Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo had so many troops, that if he wanted to kill Dong Zhuo, he needed people, he needed troops!
Therefore, Cao Cao said to the people in his hometown, “Dong Zhuo is an evil person!
Because of him, the emperor is unable to do his job well. The emperor is afraid of him and asked me to kill him.
But when I was about to kill him, I was found out.
Therefore, Dong Zhuo has now sent many people to find me. He wants to kill me.
For the sake of the emperor, let’s work together and kill Dong Zhuo!
If Dong Zhuo is no longer alive, the emperor will be able to do his job well!”
Cao Cao did not speak the truth, but he knew that he had to say it like this.
The people listened to the emperor’s words, so he had to say that it was the emperor who asked him to kill Dong Zhuo.
At that time, the people did not even have money to eat.
Everyone thought: If the emperor is able to do his job well, they will have money to eat.
So, just as Cao Cao had thought, after he spoke, everyone believed his words, and many people came to Cao Cao’s side.
Cao Cao acquired his first troops.
Generals from many places also came to Cao Cao’s side. Everyone decided that they would fight Dong Zhuo together!
